title: 메이플스토리
prompt:
INPUT: text only — no reference image is needed; do not reuse earlier conversation images.

GAME: «메이플스토리» (MapleStory), 2003. Genre: massively multiplayer online role-playing game. Graphics era: early 3D.

NOT ITS CHARACTERS: an original woman who is the game itself — no face or body of its hero, mascot, characters or creatures (she may wear their outfits); no title logo, box art, real brands, HUD overlay or readable text and numbers. Its items, places, colors, gear and interface shapes may appear recognizably.

NEVER DRAW for this game: "원작 영웅·NPC의 얼굴"; "몬스터의 똑같은 디자인(주황 버섯의 얼굴 등)"; "로고·타이틀 글자"; "화면 위 경험치 바·HUD"; "읽히는 글자·숫자".

STYLE: Glossy Korean mobile-game character art with an elegant anime face, smooth dimensional shading, luminous color accents and refined costume and accessory rendering. Keep highlights selective and the figure sharply readable.

SIGNATURE (recognizable, as the game shows them): "바람에 흩날리는 단풍잎", "통통 튀는 주황 버섯", "빨강·파랑 물약 병", "구름 위에 떠 있는 발판 길".

Quoted notes may be Korean; read them as description, never render them as text.

SUBJECT: one adult woman who personifies the video game itself. Persona: "단풍잎 섬에서 출발해 점프로 맵을 건너다니는 씩씩한 초보 모험가". Desire: "모든 마을을 돌고 가장 높은 레벨에 오르기"; conflict: "혼자 사냥하는 재미와 파티로 가야만 깰 수 있는 길". Its symbols become costume motifs drawn the way the game shows them, worn, not carried, unless her form or pose puts one in hand: "단풍잎", "주황 버섯", "포션".

AGE: in her twenties — smooth youthful skin; minimal facial lines (no nasolabial folds, crow's feet, under-eye bags or cheek creases) whatever her expression.

CORE PLAY: "점프로 발판을 오르내리며 사냥하고, 레벨이 오르면 전직해 새 스킬을 얻는다" — shown in her bearing and small costume details, never as effects, numbers or a HUD.

ERA LOOK: early 3D era — clean angular tailoring, faceted panels like simple polygons, cool metallic edges — in fabric and trim only, never pixel art or a screenshot.

SILHOUETTE: petite, small-framed build; a long ponytail; sunset-pink hair; garment structure: a one-piece dress; main material: soft felt and cotton appliquéd with maple-leaf shapes; palette: maple orange, mint green and cream.

FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): softly square face; soft droopy eyes; thin arched brows; small button nose; wide smiling mouth; sky-blue eyes; broad Korean ancestry with individual variation, no stereotyped features.

FORM — TITLE (타이틀): "단풍잎 브로치를 단 초보자 원피스와 멜빵 가방". Battle role: scout. Stage of play: the first power-on — her cleanest look, genre colors most vivid.
GEAR in the game's own style: "초보자풍 — 셔츠와 멜빵 가방".

SETTING (this form): "단풍나무가 늘어선 첫 마을 언덕 — 맑은 아침" — calm start-screen composition — centered, uncluttered, cool clean light, dark negative space.

HOLD BACK: these moments belong to the open images — keep their events out of this setting, even as a distant figure or reflection: "단풍잎이 회오리처럼 일며 발판들이 하늘로 계단처럼 이어진다"; "지팡이 끝의 빛이 터지며 구름 사이로 별 무리가 쏟아진다"; "시계탑 둘레로 빛의 고리가 퍼지며 노을 하늘이 갈라진다". An object named in FORM or in her pose stays.

EXPOSURE (bold): cut the FORM costume to show skin through its own structure — a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, a fitted corset-like waist, and bare shoulders, arms or thighs where the garment allows, kept symmetrical. The collar opens with the neckline in a V or folds down, never standing away from the neck. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; keep the FORM costume, material and palette.

PRESENTATION: a polished, glamorous adult game card illustration — a beautiful face within her FACE structure; a dense, high-detail costume with glossy trim, clasps and jewelry framing her game's material; luminous rim light, strong value contrast.

STANCE (this form): "발판 끝에서 한 발을 들고 뛰어오르려는 자세" — held still and centered, seen at eye level, easy to read as a card.

EXPRESSION (TITLE): one mouth corner lifted higher than the other, lips closed, gaze slightly to the side — the mood of this stage, on her own face.

OUTPUT: one full-body card image of this form, which also fixes who she is for every later form. Vertical 2:3 frame (1024×1536), full body with head and feet inside the frame and clear margins, nothing in front of her but what she holds, face toward the camera (front or three-quarter, never a back view). Build the background from SETTING; it evokes her game's world without being a screenshot or level map.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border, no game interface or score.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: natural human hands. Her hands do only what STANCE says and hold only what it names.

FINAL CHECK: glossy Korean mobile-game rendering with selective highlights; an original costume — no character, logo, title lettering or interface from the game.
